subject: Pilot wrap: Quantify.ai impact summary + quick reference ask
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@quantify.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap: Quantify.ai impact summary + quick reference ask

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for running the POC with us this month. Short recap of what we observed during the two-week pilot (attached is the short PDF with raw graphs):

- End-to-end tail latency (95th/99th token): down from ~520ms to ~210ms (≈60% reduction)
- Average inference cost per request: down ~42% vs your current managed endpoint (normalized)
- Sustained throughput: increased from ~30 rps to ~95 rps on the same traffic profile (3x)
- Error rate and model stability: 99.2% successful completions, no model drift observed in A/B checks

Really strong signals for the use case you shipped — happy to walk through the dashboard if helpful.

A quick ask: would Quantify.ai be open to two small things that help our GTM?
1) A two-line quote we can use in a one-pager (attribution to your name/title/company is fine).
2) A short 10-minute reference call with a product/ops peer sometime this week so we can capture a 15–30s soundbite for a case study.

If yes, proposed times (PDT): Thu Aug 5, 11:00–11:20 or Fri Aug 6, 09:00–09:20. If those don't work, tell me one time that does and we'll adapt.

Attachment: Quantify_Pilot_Report_20270804.pdf (summary + charts)

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@quantify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@quantify.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: Quantify.ai impact summary + quick reference ask

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the PDF — solid work from the Redwood team. We ran the internal verification overnight and confirmed the headline numbers you shared. To be specific from our monitoring:

- E2E p99 latency fell from ~520ms to ~210ms under our production-like load (60% reduction).
- Cost per inference (per 10k tokens) decreased by ~42% using your batching + KV caching settings vs our existing endpoint.
- Throughput improving from ~30 rps to ~95 rps allowed us to remove the extra replica we were planning to spin up.

We can provide a short quote. Draft below — you can attribute to me as "Samira Khan, Head of Product, Quantify.ai":

"Redwood's inference platform reduced our 99th‑percentile latency and inference spend materially during a short POC — the improvements made an immediate difference in UX and cost projections."

We can also do a 10-minute call. Thu Aug 5 at 11:00 PDT works for Arjun and me (that was one of your suggested slots).

I'll attach the dashboard snapshot we used to verify the numbers (dashboard-snapshot-quantify.png).

— Samira
Samira Khan | Head of Product, Quantify.ai
samira.khan@quantify.ai | +1 (212) 555-0789
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@quantify.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: Quantify.ai impact summary + quick reference ask

Samira — incredible, that quote reads great, thanks. Appreciate the dashboard snapshot as well.

Two tiny asks before we publish the one‑pager:
- Confirm attribution line: "Samira Khan, Head of Product, Quantify.ai" (you already included this — just checking).
- Can we use the sentence verbatim in a short customer one‑pager and a tweet-sized blurb? We'll not include any internal telemetry beyond the high-level numbers you already consented to.

Call confirmed: Thu Aug 5, 11:00 PDT — I'll send a calendar invite for a 10-minute sync. Vivek and Grace are on the invite to capture technical and ops details.

Thanks again — we aim to have the one‑pager draft to you by next week for a quick signoff.

— Ben
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@quantify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@quantify.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: Quantify.ai impact summary + quick reference ask

Ben —

All good to go, you have permission to use the quote as written and attribute it to me: 

Samira Khan, Head of Product, Quantify.ai

Also fine to use the high-level metrics you listed on the one‑pager (p99 latency delta, cost reduction, throughput uplift). No problem publishing the two-line quote in social or collateral.

Confirming we kept the call as scheduled yesterday — thanks for the quick sync. Happy to be a reference for potential customers; if you need anything more formal for the case study (logo usage, review cycle) let me know and Arjun will route it on our side.

Attachment: (none)

Best —
Samira
